skills.name: explain-plainly
skills.description: 방금 데이터/기술 근거로 설명했는데 사용자가 "무슨 말인지 모르겠다 / 이게 뭐냐 / 쉽게 / 정확히 뭘 묻는 거냐"라고 되물을 때, 같은 내용을 실제 비즈니스·UI 용어로 재구성해 이해하기 쉽게 다시 설명한다. 특히 그 설명을 고객사·현업·벤더에게 전달해 확인받아야 할 때(전달용 질문 문구가 필요할 때) 쓴다.
bestFor: Reframing technical or data-based explanations in business and UI terms
Helping non-developer stakeholders understand without dropping information
Producing copy-ready questions to confirm with clients, operators, or vendors
skills.effect: Keeps the facts intact while changing only the level of abstraction: anchors each point to the system, screen label, or workflow the reader actually uses, and when needed supplies a quote-ready confirmation question, flagging sample or unverified data instead of promoting it to certainty.

skills.name: executive-status-brief
skills.description: 업무 진행을 임원 보고 수준의 한국어로 요약한다. 경영진 대상 진행 보고 또는 진행상황·결정과 trade-off·필요한 맥락을 전체 1300자 이내로 정리해 달라는 요청에 사용한다.
bestFor: Summarizing verified progress, decisions and trade-offs, and context
Concise reports within 1,300 characters by default
skills.effect: Produces a three-section Korean report that distinguishes verified outcomes from plans, requests only necessary decisions, and states relevant context without implying execution approval.

skills.name: multi-agent-maintainability-review
skills.description: Run a scoped, read-only maintainability review using multiple subagents, consolidating findings into actionable recommendations.
bestFor: Architecture, framework, testing, documentation, and operations assessments
skills.effect: Guides Codex through a bounded review workflow that dispatches explorer and reviewer agents, deduplicates findings, and produces a prioritized maintainability report.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile, covering design systems, accessibility, layout, typography, color, animation, product patterns, and chart choices.
bestFor: Designing or improving web and mobile interfaces
Reviewing UI code for usability, accessibility, and visual consistency
Choosing product-appropriate layouts, styles, color systems, typography, and interaction patterns
skills.effect: Gives Codex a structured UI/UX decision framework with prioritized rules for accessibility, interaction, performance, layout, style, forms, navigation, and data visualization.
